generationArguments.prompt: Create a NEW crisp detailed pixel-art fighter sprite atlas on TRANSPARENT RGBA. EXACTLY 8 ROWS by 4 COLUMNS:32 genuinely different FULL-BODY poses. Tall portrait sheet, empty alpha gutters30px and outerpadding30px. Each head, hand, foot, carried gun and muzzle flash fully fits its own cell. ALL eight rows present including row4 round-defeat. No text, grid, scenery, floor shadow, enemy, victim or gore. Default facing RIGHT, three-quarter side view. Adult human proportions and coherent same costume/equipment in all32 cells. Keep body scale/density constant throughout the source and preserve actual crouches; never shrink the person just because a gun is long. Aim190px standing body in eventual256px cells. This is original adapted choreography from GHOST IN THE SHELL: STAND ALONE COMPLEX, FIRST TV SEASON2002 ONLY. Do NOT import 1995film, ARISE, SAC2045CG or liveaction costumes. The attached prior local bitmap is imperfect context, NOT official art: correct its missing equipment/design according to this brief. All32 complete bodies must remain visibly present. Real conventional firearms, not eye lasers, hand beams, hardlight guns or magic hologram attacks. Only a SMALL localized physical muzzle flash during actual firing; no long painted projectile (runtime draws projectile). Eight rows top to bottom INTRO, OUTRO, ROUNDVICTORY, ROUNDDEFEAT, FINISHER, VICTORY, DEFEAT, SUPER. Four distinct sequential complete-body poses in each row. ADULT MOTOKO KUSANAGI2002 SAC: angular adult face, short dark PURPLE/BLUE bob with forward bangs, RED irises, no visor/helmet. Selected modest FIELD TACTICAL outfit: full-coverage fitted charcoal/navy long-sleeve tactical jumpsuit, dark fitted tactical pants, slim gray/black tactical vest/belt, black boots and fingerless gloves. His coat must be closed over his torso, no open trench, visible belt harness, weapons, guns or code magic. Preserve this specific film identity; correct the old reference’s open coat. Empty-handed martial combination: settles in a bent-knee guard, steps forward with a straight palm strike, pivots into a controlled high side kick, draws the leg back into guard. Four distinct full-body poses; no opponents, impact burst, flying projectile, giant green explosion or body beam. All timing, targeting and finite gameplay effects are adapted; no official1:1 frames are certified.

entry.name: Morpheus
entry.sourceReference: Morpheus from The Matrix Reloaded (2003), bald Black adult man, strong face, distinctive small oval mirrored PENCE-NEZ sunglasses clipped to nose WITHOUT temple arms, long dark purple-black textured crocodile-pattern leather coat, dark purple tailored vest/shirt and dark trousers, heavy black shoes. His freeway-sequence KATANA is a complete thin curved steel sword with normal hilt and guard held in real hands. No staff, cane, futuristic firearm, huge fantasy sword or red pill power. Physical katana sequence: brings the katana into a two-handed ready position, steps into a diagonal cut, completes the blade arc with twisted torso and bent knee, returns the whole sword to a safe low guard. Four different poses; full blade remains inside each cell, no detached slash projectile, glowing code or impact explosion. entry.name: Jack O'Neill
entry.sourceReference: Colonel Jack O’Neill from Stargate SG-1 SEASON FOUR (2000–2001), adult older white man, short graying brown hair, clean-shaven face, olive-green military field shirt and fatigues, black plain tactical vest with practical pouches, SG-1/USAF patches on upper sleeves, black boots. NO sci-fi plate armor, glowing blue parts or futuristic rifle. Real BLACK FN P90 with top horizontal translucent magazine and thumbhole stock, human right hand on grip, left hand supporting front. entry.name: Marcus Fenix
entry.sourceReference: Marcus Fenix from Gears of War2(2008): white adult man, square rugged face, short dark stubble, dark black/navy bandana with its small forehead insignia; bulky charcoal/navy COG cuirass, round blue armor lights, full dark armored arms, pouches, heavy knee armor and boots. Preserve his actual Mk2 Lancer with visible underslung chainsaw in calm phases. No hat, beard-age shift, cape or later costume. A true Hammer of Dawn targeting sequence: lower/slung Lancer and bring up the distinct handheld Hammer targeting designator, steady that boxy rounded-front military laser-designator unit in BOTH hands while aiming toward screen right, a tiny red targeting light appears at its actual optical emitter, lower the designator and recover. The destruction comes from an EXTERNAL ORBITAL SATELLITE, so do NOT paint a horizontal destructive beam from his body or handheld unit, nor any large distant orbital explosion in this character cell. Only the small designator light/local targeting cue belongs in this sprite. No rifle masquerading as an arm cannon. All choreography, condensed timelines, protection and targeting are authored gameplay adaptations; no official1:1 animation is certified.
